Digital Video Advertising Formats

In-stream video (Pre-roll and mid-roll)

Video ads can run before and in between the programming content. These ads can run for up to 30 seconds without being skipped. Pre-roll and mid-roll ads are available across desktop, mobile web, mobile apps, and emerging platforms.

Connected TV

Also called over-the-top (OTT), this is television connected to the internet for streaming video content. As a growing trend in Canada’s digital marketplace, provide additional reach to your target audience with in-stream video ads: pre- and mid-roll available on Bell Media apps delivered through connected devices onto the big screen.

Outstream

Outstream video expands within the article content as the unit is scrolled into view. This reader-friendly format displays on both desktop and mobile websites. Its high viewability increases engagement and brand awareness

Vertical Video

These video-formatted display ads, also called Mobile in-unit vertical video, play in a vertical (portrait) orientation rather than the typical horizontal (landscape) orientation. Available via 300 x 600 or video app interstitials.

Frequently Asked Questions

Connected TV advertising delivers video ads through internet-connected television devices—Smart TVs, Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire Stick, and gaming consoles. Ads appear within streaming content on platforms like Sportsnet+, CTV, Crave, Amazon Prime Video, and more, combining the premium big-screen experience of traditional TV with digital-level targeting and measurement.

We place ads across all major Canadian and North American streaming platforms including Sportsnet+, TSN Direct, CTV, Crave, Amazon Prime Video, HGTV, Discovery+, YouTube TV, Hulu, Paramount+, and many more. Our network partnerships give you access to premium inventory across sports, entertainment, news, and lifestyle content.

CTV offers precise audience targeting based on demographics, interests, geography, and behavior—something traditional linear TV can’t match. You also get real-time performance data, completion rate tracking, and cross-device attribution. CTV reaches the growing cord-cutter audience that traditional TV misses entirely.

We support pre-roll (before content), mid-roll (during content), outstream (within article content), vertical video (mobile-optimized), and interactive overlays. Ad lengths range from 6-second bumpers to 30-second spots. All formats are non-skippable on most CTV platforms, ensuring full message delivery.

We track video completion rates, reach and frequency, brand lift, website visit attribution, and cross-device conversions. Our reporting dashboards provide real-time insights so you can see exactly how your campaigns perform and optimize in-flight for maximum ROI.

CTV campaigns can be tailored to a range of budgets. Unlike traditional TV which requires large upfront commitments, CTV allows for more flexible spending with CPM-based pricing. We recommend a minimum 4-week flight to build meaningful reach and frequency, and we’ll optimize your budget allocation across platforms for the best results.
